discovery.timing: static code review after both GPU preflights failed and before any D2-D5 process entered Python
discovery.issue: The first implementation used O4 query_scores scale slot 0 for D4. O4 retains three registered scale slots, so choosing slot 0 would mix a scale choice into the intended no-region-pooling diagnostic.

replacement_D4.D4_s0: Use O4 final canonical-negative probability at registered scale slot 0 only.
replacement_D4.D4_s1: Use O4 final canonical-negative probability at registered scale slot 1 only.
replacement_D4.D4_s2: Use O4 final canonical-negative probability at registered scale slot 2 only.
replacement_D4.D4_per_primitive_max: Use the fixed, target-independent maximum of the three final canonical-negative probabilities independently for every primitive/query.
replacement_D4.teacher_unavailable_rows: Exact abstention at score zero for all four variants.
replacement_D4.metrics: Available-row and end-to-end primitive metrics are reported independently for all four variants.

replacement_D5.memberships: Threshold each of the four corrected D4 score tensors independently at the unchanged fixed probability 0.6.
replacement_D5.renderer: Render all four memberships through the identical frozen final renderer.
replacement_D5.selection: All four D5 results must be reported. No result-dependent choice, promotion, fallback, threshold scan, or scale selection is permitted.

unchanged: D3 registered top-1024 greedy union oracle
positive versus maximum canonical-negative relevance semantics

execution.next_action: correct implementation and complete CPU-only static and synthetic validation
